other_information: As a student was imprisoned for one year under the M.I.S.A. during the Emergency in 1976; Organiser, D.M.K., District Student’s Wing, 1978; Deputy Secretary, D.M.K. Youth Wing, Tamil Nadu, 1982-92; Secretary, D.M.K. Student’s Wing, Tamil Nadu, 1992-2007; Propaganda Secretary, D.M.K.; Chairman, (i) Employees Progressive Union, OFT, Tiruchi, (ii) Retired Employees Union B.H.E.L., Tiruchi and (iii) Old Boys Er. Hr. Sec. School, Tiruchi; Patron (i) All India Awardees Teachers Federation, Tamil Nadu and (ii) Alumni Association, Periyar E.V.R. College; Major Achievements: Five-term Parliamentarian (since 1996); awarded (i) Universal Peace Award 2020 by Universal Peace Federation (an NGO in General Consultative Status with the Economic and Social Council of the United Nations) and (ii) Best Parliamentarian Award 2019; Member in important Select Committees of Parliament; Nominated to the Panel of Vice-Chairmen on multiple occasions; participated in 864 Parliamentary debates (till July 2024); raised 1845 Parliamentary Questions (till July 2024); introduced 8 Private Members’ Bills (till July 2024) including the historic Private Member (Transgender Rights) Bill
